title: If Your Mom Ever Says Goodnight to You Twice... LOCK YOUR DOOR
description:
She already said goodnight. You heard her footsteps go back down the hall.
So why is she outside your door, saying it again?

If your mom ever says goodnight twice, lock your door. Don't answer. Don't open it. Just listen, because the voice in the hallway knows exactly how she sounds, and it's hoping you don't know the rules.

These are the rules that get you to morning.

You were never taught these rules. Someone should have.

Subscribe before the lights go out.

All stories on this channel are fiction.

#analoghorror #horrorrules #scarystories

title: What If You Were Born as Ghost? | Call of Duty
description:
You're a baby. No mask. No gun. And the scariest thing in your house? Your dad. Years later, you're in the SAS, on loan to an American team hunting a cartel boss in Mexico. Your own commander sells you out. You're captured and tortured for months, but you never break. So the cartel boss buries you alive, in a coffin with your commander's body. You dig your way out with his jawbone. Then you come home to Christmas Eve… and lose everything. This is the whole life of Simon "Ghost" Riley, from the boy in Manchester to the man behind the skull mask, told as if it were yours.

The comic, Modern Warfare 2, the betrayal in the field, and the new games where your story starts over from zero.

How do you think Ghost got his mask? And which game character should be born next? Tell me in the comments.

title: What If You Could See Everyone's IQ?
description:
What if you could see everyone's IQ floating above their heads? 🧠👀

Imagine having a genius-level IQ of 160 but still failing your exams, while the smartest-looking student in class gets straight A's with only 70 IQ. 💀

But when the two compete to prove who's actually smarter, things take an unexpected turn.

Does having a higher IQ really make you smarter, or is there more to intelligence than just a number? 🤔

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Future Wealth?
description:
What if you could see how rich everyone will become? 💰

Imagine walking past a homeless man, only to discover he's destined to become a billionaire. But what happens when you realize the future isn't guaranteed?

Would you use this power to get rich, or change someone's life? 👀

title: What IF You Could See Who Has a Crush on You?
description:
What if you could see who has a crush on you? 💘 You walk into a room, and a glowing heart appears above someone’s head. Then another lights up above a friend you’ve known for years. Suddenly, all those awkward conversations and unexpected smiles start making sense—or do they?

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine everyday life with the power to spot secret crushes: discovering unexpected admirers, trying to act normal around your friends, and nervously waiting to see whether a heart appears above your own crush. Every introduction could bring a surprise, but knowing someone likes you wouldn’t tell you what to say next.

Would you tell people about your ability or keep what you see to yourself? A crush wouldn’t guarantee compatibility, and someone’s feelings could change before you found the courage to start a conversation. Could you build a connection without letting those floating hearts make every decision for you?

This romantic what-if adventure explores attraction, friendship, and the unexpected awkwardness of knowing who likes you. Would your power make dating easier—or leave you overthinking every heart that appeared and disappeared?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:
💬 What If Real Life Gave You Dialogue Options?
👁️ What If You Could See Everyone’s Biggest Secret?
🧠 What If You Had Psychic Powers?
🍀 What If You Could Control Your Luck?

If you could see who had a crush on you, would you want to know? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more animated what-if scenarios, strange abilities, and imaginary challenges!

#WhatIf #Crush #SecretCrush #Superpowers #Animation #AnimatedStories

title: Zombie Outbreak: What If YOU Were Patient Zero? (Full Story)
description:
Your heart beats nine times a minute, and you feel amazing. You haven't slept in four days, and the dog won't come near you. You're turning into a zombie, slowly, and in nine days your whole town will be hunting the first one. But were you really the first?

The fungus is based on a real one: it takes over an ant's muscles and makes it bite down on a leaf at noon. A dog smells at least ten thousand times better than you, and for a few days, so do you. Then a red number shows up over someone in your own house, and you find out you can pull the strings of any zombie, but every pull costs you one percent.

Zombie Outbreak Parts 1, 2 and 3, all in one film.

title: Zombie Outbreak Survival: Trapped In a Farm Day 1 To Day 100 (Full Movie!)
description:
What if a zombie outbreak trapped you on an isolated farm for 100 days? No rescue is coming, supplies are running low, and hundreds of infected are roaming outside. Every decision could mean the difference between survival and becoming one of them.

#zombie #survival #apocalypse

This animated zombie apocalypse survival story follows your fight to survive from Day 1 to Day 100 on a farm overrun by the undead. You'll need to secure the property, find food and clean water, fortify your defenses, manage limited supplies, and make impossible choices as the outbreak gets worse. But surviving the zombies is only half the battle. Isolation, unexpected dangers, and the constant threat of losing everything will test how long you can hold on.

Could you survive 100 days on a farm during a zombie apocalypse? Watch the full story to find out, and tell me in the comments what you would do differently.

#zombie #survival #zombieapocalypse #whatif #animation #apocalypse #zombiesurvival #100days #survivalstory #endofworld

title: Absolute Zero: 100 Hours Survival in a Frozen City
description:

title: What If You Woke Up 20,000 Years Ago?
tags: what if you woke up 20000 years ago
description:
What if you woke up 20,000 years ago — in the middle of the Ice Age?

No electricity. No supermarkets. No modern medicine. Just a world of freezing temperatures, unfamiliar landscapes, and people who know exactly how to survive in it.

In this video, we travel back to Upper Paleolithic Europe and imagine what a single day among our prehistoric ancestors might have been like.

How did people stay warm? What did they eat? How did they make tools, find shelter, and survive in a world without modern technology?

And perhaps the most surprising question of all: were these ancient humans really so different from us?

Explore the daily lives, survival skills, intelligence, and social connections of Homo sapiens living approximately 20,000 years ago.

This is a science-based reconstruction of prehistoric life, not a literal account of one documented day. Some details are informed by archaeological evidence, while others are plausible interpretations.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for more fascinating stories about human history, science, evolution, and the hidden mechanisms of our world.

#Prehistory #IceAge #HumanEvolution
